steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Singing...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Wow, it's echoing through the whole town...
A pale blue light spills over the desolate streets. In amongst the flickers of illumination, are people and the lives they led.
The two stand alone in an otherwise empty town. The hazy song weaves into a web, and the sun continues to set.
Exposed Originium clusters, restless protesters, pale starlight, and mud bricks all fall silent together.
All that remains... is the song...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What is this... what am I seeing? Are these Originium Arts?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: A folk song...? Or a poem? At sunset?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Is this a Wolumonde tradition?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Um... Miss Folinic, do you understand the lyrics?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No... is that the Leithanian tongue? It doesn't sound like modern Leithanian pronunciation...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But... it sounds nice.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: It reminds me of looking out over the plains from the bridge of Rhodes Island for the very first time. It's melodious... ancient...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: This is... also Arts... but the same kind as the ancient Arts of Higashi!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Find them.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Sure, but then what? Arrest them?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: That'll just stir up even more resentment.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We're doing this to keep them from fomenting animosity between Infected and non-infected. The Winterwisps may well have been behind all this.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mr. Severin?! Wh-what is this?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: It's a Winterwisp ballad, for rituals and funerals.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The Winterwisps are responsible for agitating Infected conflicts and leading the partisans to destroy our power plant.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Now is not the time for leniency. They're trying to tell us something.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They wouldn't tip their hand for no reason. There must be others out there in the shadows. Probably casters. Keep an eye out.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What exactly is a Winterwisp?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Local Caprinae. They were the people of these mountains, centuries ago.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: What happened to them?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Wolumonde clashed with the Winterwisp. Nothing more.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No. There's more to it than that.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Columbia and Rim Billiton, pretty much every country has some kind of history of settler colonialism. There's another force at work here.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're just looking for a simple answer to dodge the question, aren't you? You'll just leave it as 'conflicts' and 'clashes?'

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'm not sure I should be talking about this with you. It goes beyond what Rhodes Island has a need to know...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: A Gendarmerie telling these things to a foreign enterprise will make certain aristocrats very unhappy.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're... worried about unhappy aristocrats...?!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Atro sacrificed herself for you! And you're talking about saving face?!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: M-Miss Folinic! Her sacrifice... shouldn't be ammunition for an argument.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Mr. Severin...! Can you please stop this manhunt? It's only agitating people. It's only going to make things worse!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No... We're following our only lead. We can't afford to lose it.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Severin, with as many nomadic cities as there are in Leithanien, do you really think any of those nobles give a shit about you from atop their ivory towers?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Even considering the Great Rift, if a nearby city were to offer support, would there really be a famine?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Severin, look at the situation. See for yourself who is really here to help you!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know... Miss Folinic. I know better than anyone.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But I also know Rhodes Island can't help us forever. Once we're safe again and Wolumonde is back on course, I don't want to be getting letters from those ivory towers.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: You have to understand that.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But Miss Folinic, we—

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: —An explosion?! Another attack?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: Schultz! Help! We need help!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Slow down. What happened?

steps.name: Townsfolk
steps.text: They, they activated those town defense things! They exploded, and everything's burning, they—!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Calm down!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz! The Infected... they've captured all of the Gendarmerie patrolling Zwölftontechnik Strasse! We lost contact with them!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They're using the Gramophones to push us back. The whole district is out of control!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They shouldn't be so well-organized. Who's leading them?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: We don't know. But a lot of the non-infected have joined the protest. Wolumonde is completely divided!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Ugh. Damn you, Winterwisps...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Surround the district. Control the crowd. We have to take the town back.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Cough* *cough*, *hack* *cough*!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Damn it... You get back to the Rathaus and sound the alarm. This has devolved into something far worse than just a dispute between the Infected.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I'm putting Wolumonde under martial law. Raise the entire militia.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But if we start killing each other now, Wolumonde won't survive the winter!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I gave you an order!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Y-yes sir!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: As for you Rhodes Islanders... Do what you feel is right.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: To be frank, I don't have time to keep an eye on you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I still need more information.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: B-but we should do what we can to help people first... A lot of innocent civilians are getting caught up in this mess...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We'll find the killer. That takes priority.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...I promise, Wolumonde will provide Rhodes Island with a satisfactory answer.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I hope you'll keep that promise.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If I'm still alive by then.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: ...Miss Folinic, we should have stopped Mr. Severin.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No use. You saw them. The pressure's gotten to them.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Oh... is that so?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: But if a famine really is as imminent as the officer says, we'll still have to...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...The only way to calm everyone down is to find the murderer as soon as possible. And letting our one lead go cold isn't an option.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That's not what I meant...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic, do you really think finding the killer will solve all our problems?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Try to stay calm, Miss Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Suzuran?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You know... everyone is burning with rage right now. Nobody has a clear head.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I think... it's just my gut feeling, but my intuition is usually pretty accurate!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: I think maybe... something even worse is starting to happen. The kind of thing that you can't be sure if it's right or wrong...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: What we have to do is try to help as many innocent people as we can.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Miss Folinic... If we don't stop Mr. Severin, things are going to get really, really bad.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: ...Maybe you're right.
